name: trove-video-edit
description: Edit a pre-cut talking-head video: captions, overlays, zooms, and a music bed. Use when the cut is already made and the edit is what remains. Not for raw multi-take footage and not for finding b-roll in a clip. Use when: edit this pre-cut video; add captions and overlays to this cut; one-shot edit this intro; add music and zooms to this talking head.
